enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and reading news before breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through headlines. Tap on article. Read. Swipe to next article. Read. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 2 at the kitchen table
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place frying pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into pan. Stir. Put bread in toaster. Pour milk into glasses. Set table. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Talk with Member 2. Drink milk. Finish eating. Pick up plates. Carry to sink. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt, pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand in front of mirror. Adjust shirt. Open work bag. Put in laptop. Put in charger. Put in notebook. Put in pen. Put in phone. Put in keys. Put in wallet. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Attend meeting. Take notes. Write report. Organize files. Use computer. Print documents. File documents. Make more phone calls. Send emails. Update program schedule. Talk to supervisor.

Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Read news. Throw away trash. Stand up. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office. Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, meeting partners and planning program logistics
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to conference room. Shake hands with partners. Sit down. Open laptop. Turn on projector. Show slides. Discuss program logistics. Take notes. Ask questions. Answer questions. Make phone calls. Send emails. Plan schedule. Assign tasks. Close laptop. Stand up. Shake hands again. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Continue working on computer.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Greet Member 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2, using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir-fry. Add vegetables. Stir-fry. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plates. Set table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 2. Finish eating. Pick up plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape plates into trash. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in drying rack. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Member 2 helps dry dishes. Put away dishes. Wipe stove. Turn off kitchen light. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV, joined by Member 2 until 19:30
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Talk with Member 2. Member 2 leaves at 19:30. Continue watching TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch more TV. Stand up. Get snack. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn on tap. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and checking phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Reply to messages. Open social media. Scroll. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read more pages. Close book. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down in bed.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Fall asleep. Remain asleep.
